If you prefer not to use the Unified inbox, you can turn it off. Navigate to settings > general settings > display: Show Unified Inbox

There's not a favourite folder feature in the way you describe. The closest the app comes is the "Show in top group" folder option. This places the folder nearer the top of the folder tree, making it a little more accessible and less nested.

To toggle the option.

1. Open the side panel with your account folder list displayed. 2. Tap manage folders (bottom of list) 3. Tap an applicable folder. 4. Toggle "Show in top group" ON.

Feel free to suggest your favourite folder idea on Mozilla connect where community members can vote for it. Those with high vote counts have a greater chance of being selected for development.
